newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 15.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- NATO and Russia to sign cooperation deal in Paris on May 27, called the NATO-Russia Founding Act.

-- Dasa chairman Manfred Bischoff says in an interview that an alliance between Dasa and Lagardere, to bid for defence electronics group Thomson-CSF, applies to some clearly-defined sectors only. He says these are outside of the major areas in which Dasa co-operates with Aerospatiale.
-- Strike by traffic controllers at SNCF railway operator will continue this week-end, while Air France flights are expected to be hit by a strike from May 20 to 23.
